description: Reports what each piece of the plan's work produced against its forecast over the last days: per row its id, title, kind, channel, state, forecast, totals by metric (visits, sign-ups, orders, revenue, reach, opens, clicks and the rest), status (behind, on, ahead, or unknown when nothing was measured) and whether any number was attributed to it; then the totals by channel and by kind, and how many rows are behind, on, ahead or unknown. Use it to judge the plan's work; one row whole is work_get, a business-wide number day by day is metrics_series, and the Analytics place (place_open analytics) has every number. Only numbers attributed to a piece of work count here.

days.description: The span, in days ending today (7 for the week, 30 for the month).

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
